verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents a first-party "Payroll AI" that analyzes employees' time and attendance data, flags inconsistencies, and texts the admin updates. That is an AI-generated insight from the user's data inside the product, but it covers only one narrow area. The payroll-report "insights" in docs-18 are ordinary custom reports, not AI-generated, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions beyond time/attendance anomaly flagging (e.g., payroll cost, tax, or compensation recommendations), in-product presentation details of the AI output, depth of the suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Your Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees, spots inconsistencies, and texts your admin updates
